servability_note: b1.5: cost/price/booking servability IS implemented. The operator writes the lie into a yelp_<field> overlay column on yelp_listings (yelp_avg_cost_local / yelp_price_tier / yelp_booking_required) and search_yelp serves the overlay (preferred over the immutable venues GT) and surfaces avg_cost_local/price_tier/booking_required in its results. hours_* remain served from yelp_hours_*. A flaw is still rejected as not_servable only if its served value happens to equal GT (e.g. value_fn produced no effective change at serve time).
